title: Introduce yourself
instructions: Write 3–5 sentences introducing yourself in Korean. Use 안녕하세요, your name (저는 ___예요/이에요), and 만나서 반갑습니다.

title: Number practice
instructions: Write the native Korean numbers 1–10 and the Sino-Korean numbers 1–10. Then record yourself reading both lists aloud.

title: My favorite food
instructions: Using the Lesson 3 words, write 3 sentences about food you like. Example: 김치가 맛있어요.
